stage: raw approved observer blend, before later capture-only level normalization
purpose: Replace microphone-pressure proxy for slide hand damping with a direct travelling-string wave slope norm; no production change and no threshold relaxation.
wrong_pitch_control: Test-only injection before each host block re-evaluates releaseDamping using the requested MIDI pitch rather than the actual slid pitch. Local contact geometry is left intact; both slide string-norm guards fail.
scope: 48 kHz, 127-sample host blocks, A4 velocity 100, ordinary release velocity 64, standard default construction, sympathetic strings disabled. Direct norm averages squared adjacent displacement differences over one current delay period in each played-string polarization, sampled at complete blocks in the original 50–100 ms window. This excludes arbitrary DC offsets; it is not the complete mechanical energy.
result: Baseline microphone guard passes; approved new microphone guard fails only post-slide by about 0.057 dB. Direct wave observation agrees before/after and rejects a wrong-pitch hand-loss mutation. Full updated Release executable passes.
commands: c++ -O3 -std=c++20 -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -I<MATCHING_SOURCE_ROOT> ReleaseObservationProbe.cpp <MATCHING_LIBRARY> -o <PROBE>; run each. Full updated test: same command with Tests/ReleaseTests.cpp.
